description.value: The oldest existing Sikh Temple in North America, built by Sikh migrants between 1908 and 1911, and designated a National Historic Site of Canada in 2002. The ground floor houses the Sikh Heritage Museum, which has featured rotating exhibitions on topics from the Komagata Maru to South Asians in hockey since 2011. Guided group tours are available and a virtual tour allows remote visitors to explore the site.

address.value: 33089 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2A8
